steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Health: A state of complete physical, mental and social wellbeing, not merely the absence of disease or infirmity (WHO definition). Health has three interconnected dimensions: physical, emotional/mental, and social. | Chemical Effects of Exercise on the Brain: Serotonin → Improves mood, reduces depression Endorphins → Natural painkillers, create euphoria Dopamine → Reward and motivation, reinforces positive behaviour These chemical changes explain why regular exercise is such a powerful treatment for mental health conditions. | PE Exam Tips — Physical, Emotional and Social Health: 1. For Physical, Emotional and Social Health questions, use subject-specific terminology precisely 2. Support every point with specific evidence or examples 3. Show balanced analysis — consider different perspect

steps.title: Lesson 3: Application
steps.body: Explain three physical health benefits of regular exercise. | How does exercise improve emotional and mental health? Refer to specific chemicals released during physical activity. | Describe three social health benefits of participating in sport and give a sporting example for each.

steps.body: Consolidation, retrieval on Health, and one past-paper question.
